sections.name: View
sections.description:
View constructs a retained container from children. Configure it with fluent
properties, events, and styles. Apply reusable styles with Element.Style.

go/ui/input.example:
func InputExample() *ui.Element {
	value, setValue := ui.CreateSignal("")
	return ui.Input().
		Value(value()).
		Placeholder("Write here").
		OnInputEvent(func(event *native.Event) { setValue(event.Value) }).
		Width(320).Height(32)
}

}

sections.name: combobox
sections.description: Compose named parts with .slot(@ui.Slot) and .children(children). Available slots: label, value, icon, input-group, clear, trigger, chips, chip, chip-remove, backdrop, portal, positioner, popup, arrow, status, empty, list, row, item, item-indicator, group, group-label, collection, separator.

entries.name: style
entries.description: Applies a reusable @ui.Style to this element.

entries.name: on_click
entries.description: Called after QuickGUI resolves an activation, including supported keyboard activation.

entries.name: on_input
entries.description: Receives edits from the text control. Write the new text into the controlled value.

entries.name: disabled
entries.description: Prevents activation and exposes the disabled state to accessibility. Compound parts inherit a disabled root.

entries.name: items
entries.description: Items made available to the control. Use stable item values to preserve selection.

entries.name: value
entries.description: The current controlled value. Update application state from the change callback to accept a new value.

entries.name: input_value
entries.description: Editable query text used by a combobox or autocomplete.

entries.name: multiple
entries.description: Allows more than one selected value.

entries.name: filter_mode
entries.description: Core-owned contains, prefix, fuzzy, or disabled filtering.

entries.name: on_value_change
entries.description: Reports an accepted value change. Use the callback payload to update controlled state.

entries.name: read_only
entries.description: Preserves the current value while keeping the control available for focus and inspection.

entries.name: required
entries.description: Marks the control as required for validation and accessibility.

entries.name: active_value
entries.description: Value identifying the active item in a coordinated control.

entries.name: values
entries.description: Declared values used by this coordinated control. The callback payload follows the component contract.

entries.name: orientation

moonbit/ui/tabs.example:
fn component_example() -> @ui.Element {
  let tabs = @ui.tabs([]).active_value("overview")
  tabs
  .flex_col()
  .gap(12)
  .children([
    tabs
    .slot(@ui.List)
    .flex_row()
    .gap(8)
    .children([
      tabs.slot(@ui.Tab, value="overview", index=0).label("Overview"),
      tabs.slot(@ui.Tab, value="settings", index=1).label("Settings"),
    ]),
    tabs
    .slot(@ui.Panel, value="overview")
    .children([@ui.text("Overview content")]),
    tabs
    .slot(@ui.Panel, value="settings")
    .children([@ui.text("Settings content")]),
  ])
}

moonbit/ui/scroll-area.example:
fn component_example() -> @ui.Element {
  let scroll = @ui.scroll_area([])
  scroll
  .children([
    scroll
    .slot(@ui.Viewport)
    .children([
      scroll
      .slot(@ui.Content)
      .children([@ui.text("Scrollable content")])
      .height(600),
    ])
    .size_full()
    .overflow_y("scroll"),
  ])
  .width(280)
  .height(160)
}

moonbit/ui/table.example:
fn component_example() -> @ui.Element {
  let table = @ui.data_table([])
    .columns([{ "id": "name", "track": "1fr" }])
    .row_count(1)
    .row_height(32)
    .header_height(0)
    .selection_mode("single")
  table
  .children([
    table
    .slot(@ui.Row, index=0)
    .children([table.slot(@ui.Cell, value="name").children([@ui.text("Ada")])]),
  ])
  .height(160)
  .overflow_y("scroll")
}

moonbit/ui/progress.example:
fn component_example() -> @ui.Element {
  let progress = @ui.progress([]).values([0.65]).maximum(1)
  progress
  .width(240)
  .flex_col()
  .gap(6)
  .children([
    progress.slot(@ui.Label).label("Upload"),
    progress
    .slot(@ui.Track)
    .children([progress.slot(@ui.Indicator).bg(@ui.rgb8(40, 120, 230))])
    .height(6),
    progress.slot(@ui.Value),
  ])
}

moonbit/ui/meter.example:
fn component_example() -> @ui.Element {
  let meter = @ui.meter([])
    .values([72])
    .minimum(0)
    .maximum(100)
    .low(20)
    .high(80)
    .optimum(60)
  meter
  .children([
    meter
    .slot(@ui.Track)
    .children([meter.slot(@ui.Indicator).bg(@ui.rgb8(30, 150, 90))])
    .height(8),
  ])
  .width(240)
}

moonbit/ui/dialog.example:
fn component_example() -> @ui.Element {
  let dialog = @ui.dialog([])
  dialog.children([
    dialog.slot(@ui.Trigger).label("Open dialog"),
    dialog
    .slot(@ui.Portal)
    .children([
      dialog.slot(@ui.Backdrop),
      dialog
      .slot(@ui.Popup)
      .padding(24)
      .flex_col()
      .gap(12)
      .children([
        dialog.slot(@ui.Title).label("Confirm action"),
        dialog.slot(@ui.Description).label("Review before continuing."),
        dialog.slot(@ui.Close).label("Close"),
      ]),
    ]),
  ])
}
